shapeSummary: Compact motor controller body: a 28.5 x 15.5 mm heat-shrunk board about 3.2 mm thick, joined by a narrow web to a round Ø10.1 mm mounting ear/standoff 5.6 mm thick with a Ø4 mm through hole. Overall bounds are about 40.5 x 15.5 x 5.6 mm, centered in X and Z with the bottom at Y=0. Flying leads and connectors are excluded.
warnings: Overall X length of 40.5 mm is estimated from the drawing, not stated.
The hole is placed at Y = 7.75 (mid-width) because the analysis gave Y=0 while the bottom sits at Y=0.
The board and heat-shrink thickness (3.2 mm), the board's z offset, the ear diameter and the connecting web are guesses.
It is uncertain whether the 5.6 mm thickness covers the standoff or the whole board.
Wire leads, XT30, bullet and signal connectors, the heat-shrink taper, the LED and the logos are omitted.
cadquery:
hole_x=-15.2
cy=7.75
# heat-shrink covered board (28.5 x 15.5 x 3.2)
body=cq.Workplane('XY').box(28.5,15.5,3.2).translate((6.0,cy,1.2))
# connecting web between board and ear
web=cq.Workplane('XY').box(7.0,10.1,3.2).translate((-11.75,cy,1.2))
# round mounting ear / standoff around the 4 mm hole
ear=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(5.05).extrude(5.6).translate((hole_x,cy,-2.8))
part=body.union(web).union(ear)
hole=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(2.0).extrude(8).translate((hole_x,cy,-4))
part=part.cut(hole)
